description: A stereo bit crusher and downsampler, with a wet and dry balance and modulation on all three amounts.

params.text: How much the WET jack moves that balance.
Balance between the untreated signal and the crushed one.
How far the sample rate is reduced before the signal is played back.
How much the FQ jack moves the sample rate reduction.
How far the sample word is shortened, which is the bit crushing proper.
How much the CRSH jack moves the bit crushing.
Sets how the two channels are used: up crushes left and right separately, middle drives their modulation in opposite directions, down crushes IN 1 alone and places it across the stereo pair.

inputs.text: Moves the bit crushing, by as much as the MOD knob beside BITCRUSH allows.
Moves the sample rate reduction, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ allows.
Takes the crusher out of circuit while it is high, passing the inputs through untouched.
Moves the wet and dry balance, by as much as the MOD knob beside DRY/WET allows.
Audio into the left side of the crusher.
Audio into the right side of the crusher. Left unpatched, the left input is crushed on both sides.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
